java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Biome>
org.swarmforge.core.world.Biome
All Implemented Interfaces:

public enum Biome extends Enum<Biome>
Biome presets for terrain generation. Each biome defines environmental parameters and material distributions for realistic world generation.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • FOREST

      public static final Biome FOREST
      Temperate deciduous forest. Moderate temperature, high humidity, rich soil.

    • DESERT

      public static final Biome DESERT
      Hot, arid desert. High temperature, low humidity, sandy soil.

    • GRASSLAND

      public static final Biome GRASSLAND
      Open grassland/prairie. Moderate temperature, moderate humidity.

    • TROPICAL

      public static final Biome TROPICAL
      Tropical rainforest. High temperature, very high humidity, dense vegetation.

    • MEDITERRANEAN

      public static final Biome MEDITERRANEAN
      Mediterranean climate. Warm, dry summers; mild, wet winters.

    • WETLAND

      public static final Biome WETLAND
      Wetland/marsh environment. High moisture, waterlogged soil.

    • TUNDRA

      public static final Biome TUNDRA
      Cold tundra. Very cold, low vegetation.
